summary.text: Shelley Frommeyer is a Republican state senator who has represented District 24 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Shelley Funke Frommeyer earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from the University of Kentucky in 1991.

Her career experience includes founding FFR Wealth Team and working as its CEO, working as a financial advisor with Waddell & Reed, and working as an executive recruiter with Johnson ReSource Group/Professions, Inc.
She has been affiliated with the Campbell County Leadership Action Group and the Northern Kentucky Chamber of Commerce.

In the 2025-2026 session she is vice chair of the Economic Development, Tourism and Labor Committee and serves on the Senate Appropriations and Revenue, Agriculture, and Families and Children committees.
